BiblicalUsage: Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai was prince of the children of Simeon: he offered on the fifth day at the dedication, and he led his host when the camp set forward. Three verses, one man, one tribe, one duty.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the princes of the tribes show how God orders His people. Each tribe had its prince, its day, and its place in the march, and I hold that order is part of His care.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
